info.title: Vela business API
info.description: Implemented business HTTP APIs including SSE chat and read-only compiled Prompt defaults. Turn status recovery and cancellation are supported; tuning mutations are not implemented.

post.description: SSE result confirms atomic message and quota commit. Idempotency-Key is scoped to user and session, binds the normalized request, and is retained for the account lifetime. Same-key completed requests return the saved result; running or failed requests return 409. GET the turn after disconnect; explicit retry after a terminal failure uses a new key. Token replay is not provided.

schema.description: SSE frames; JSON data follows x-event-schema
